lines.text: Every month, the same week, Nora's gut changes.
Bloated. Then running to the bathroom.
She thought it was just her.
It isn't. In one study, three in four women had gut symptoms around their period.
Hormones that shift across her month can slow her gut down, then speed it up.
Her gut was talking. So she started listening.
Her meals. Her bathroom trips. How she felt. Day by day.
Two months in, her month started to have a shape.
Something she could plan for, and show her doctor.
Download Get Regular. Trust your gut again.
